title: drupilot run manifest (runs/<run_id>/run-manifest.json)
description: One run of a pipeline step (AR-16), in the subject's hidden state dir under runs/<run_id>/: the hashes it started from and the ones it produced, so two runs can be compared. common.sh run_manifest_record writes it; DRUPILOT_RUNS_KEEP runs are kept.

run_id.description: The UTC start time and the first hex of the inputs' hash.
